items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I've found a Martin a good horn. But then, in playing heavy outdoor stuff I always have used a Holton or a C.G. Kahn.

ctx.x: Your Uncle Natty has a committee model Martin now, which she likes it. Quite a few people use those. Well, I've played Martin.
I've played Martin. I've found a Martin a good horn. But then, in playing heavy outdoor stuff I always have used a Holton or a C.G. Kahn.
A lot of the old timers over there used Kahn in the old days.
